about: SPDX ids a third-party component may carry. `ships` binds anything that reaches a binary or its installer; `not_shipped` widens it for build-, test- and docs-only components. An id on neither list needs an entry in `exceptions`, which only the human approves: `approved` takes the human's ref (an ADR, a ROADMAP row), never an agent's. `pending_human` names the unapproved exceptions the check tolerates, each with the date it was raised; they print as PENDING THE HUMAN and go red on `expires`.

dc-runtime.approved: ADR-206; the human, 2026-10-10 ("go with your recommendations"): keep it as a docs-only exception
dc-runtime.note: support.js states no license and no copyright, is not ours, and is tracked twice under docs/ in a public repository. It never ships in the plugin. The choice turns on whether the tool's terms allow redistributing its runtime, or whether both copies should leave the repository. APPROVED 2026-10-10 as a recorded docs-only exception: six tracked design pages load it and it never ships in the plugin. Still worth checking the design tool's terms on redistributing its exported runtime.

presonus-extensions.approved: ADR-204; the human, 2026-10-09 ("I'll go with your recommendation"): accept the bare public-domain statement for this one interface header
presonus-extensions.note: One header compiled into the VST3 wrapper says "Written and placed in the PUBLIC DOMAIN by PreSonus Software Ltd." and carries no license text. A public-domain statement has no SPDX id, so it cannot be on the shipping list. The choice turns on whether the human accepts a bare public-domain statement for a component that ships. APPROVED 2026-10-09 as a recorded exception; re-review at each clap-wrapper bump, and by the expiry at the latest.

not_shipped.GPL-3.0-only: copyleft; proposed ONLY for a tool CI runs as a separate program and never links, modifies or redistributes (pluginval). The human may prefer an exception instead

ships.Apache-2.0: permissive, with notice duties and an express patent grant; carried by the AudioUnitSDK
ships.BSD-2-Clause: permissive; seeded from the brief, no component carries it today
ships.BSD-3-Clause: permissive, with a no-endorsement clause; carried by WebView2Loader
ships.BSL-1.0: permissive; seeded from the brief, no component carries it today
ships.CC0-1.0: public-domain dedication with a fallback license; seeded from the brief, no component carries it today
ships.MIT: permissive; carried by CLAP, clap-wrapper, the VST 3 SDK and CPM.cmake
ships.MIT WITH fmt-exception: MIT plus an exception that lifts the notice duty for compiled code; carried by {fmt}
ships.Unlicense: public-domain dedication with a fallback license; seeded from the brief, no component carries it today
ships.Zlib: permissive; seeded from the brief, no component carries it today
